{{Quote|I've seen better in Watto's Junkyard|Gasgano to [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]]|translated=1|audio=Gasgano-taunt.flac|<ref name="Star Wars Episode I: Racer">[[Star Wars: Episode I Racer|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''Racer'']]</ref>}}
'''Gasgano''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Xexto/Legends|Xexto]] podracer pilot who participated in the [[Boonta Eve Classic/Legends|Boonta Eve Classic]] podrace. He had 24 fingers total, which allowed him to complete multiple tasks while racing.<ref name="Star Wars: The Complete Visual Dictionary">''[[Star Wars: The Complete Visual Dictionary]]''</ref>

==Biography==
{{Quote|Wow, look at that! It's the galaxy-famous Gasgano in his custom Ord Pedrovia.|Commentator [[Fodesinbeed Annodue|Fode]] spots Gasgano|audio=Fode-Gasgano.flac|<ref name="Star Wars Episode I: Racer" />}}
[[File:OrdPedrovia-RSP.png|thumb|left|300px|Gasgano's customized [[Ord Pedrovia/Legends|''Ord Pedrovia'']]]]
Easily ranking among the most famous [[Podracer/Legends|podracer]] pilots in the galaxy, Gasgano was one of the deadliest fiends on the track, if one was able to anger him. Otherwise, he would just pass other participants, focused on reaching the finish line first rather than destroying other racers' pods (a method favored by [[Sebulba/Legends|Sebulba]]). Gasgano's custom-built [[Ord Pedrovia/Legends|''Ord Pedrovia'']] placed a heavy emphasis on acceleration, helping him take the lead in the critical early seconds of a Podrace.

The Xexto had little patience for [[Human/Legends|Humans]] and often condemned lesser pilot [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] as a rookie wannabe, while at the same time being impressed that the Human boy had ever dared to strap himself into a Pod in the first place. Gasgano was championed by [[Gardulla Besadii the Elder/Legends|Gardulla Besadii the Elder]], although she was far from the only spectator who bet on him; many predicted Gasgano would overtake Sebulba in the [[Boonta Eve Classic/Legends|Boonta Eve Classic]]. Placed prominently on the grid, the Xexto took a good start when [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] gave the kickoff, and managed to stay in the front runners throughout the race. While Gasgano placed second behind Anakin in this race, Sebulba's defeat and subsequent temporary loss of dignity provided the [[Xexto/Legends|Xexto]] with an excellent chance to further his own career as a Podracer. Although Gasgano had a reputation as an intellectual, he got drunk in the nearest cantina to celebrate his victory. However, not bothering to rest from his partial victory in the Boonta, the competitive Gasgano quickly moved on to other races, and soon became the favorite pilot on the barren Podracing moon of [[Oovo IV/Legends|Oovo IV]].

During the [[Galactic Games/Legends|Galactic Games]] of [[26 BBY/Legends|26 BBY]], and among several other contestants of an illegal [[Great Dordon Caves|Caves]] race on the planet [[Euceron]] (including [[Ody Mandrell/Legends|Ody Mandrell]], [[Aldar Beedo/Legends|Aldar Beedo]], [[Kam Nale|Elan Mak]], [[Will Neluenf]], and 14-year-old [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] Anakin Skywalker), Gasgano unfortunately got tangled up with "Scorch" [[Zanales]], and the two racers crashed their pods. Skywalker won the race on behalf of the children of [[Ratts Tyerell/Legends|Ratts Tyerell]]—[[Deland Tyerell/Legends|Deland]] and [[Doby Tyerell|Doby]], whose podracer Anakin piloted to free their sister-slave [[Djulla]] from the clutches of her master, Sebulba (whose son, [[Hekula]], took second place).<ref name="Jedi Quest: The Dangerous Games">''[[Jedi Quest: The Dangerous Games]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Gasgano_swk.jpg|thumb|left|150px|Gasgano, famous pilot of the [[Galactic Podracing Circuit/Legends|Galactic Podracing Circuit]].]]
Gasgano's appearance in [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']] marked the introduction of the Xexto species to the saga. The conceptual maquette of Gasgano was designed by [[Richard Mills]] and [[Robert E. Barnes]], and his appearance in the film was computer generated.

His voice in ''[[Star Wars: Episode I Racer|Star Wars Episode I: Racer]]'' and ''[[Star Wars: Racer Revenge|Racer Revenge]]'' was provided by [[Bob Bergen]].

It is possible that Gasgano was one of the individuals present around the time of Luke Skywalker's meeting with Han Solo in [[Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina/Legends|Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina]]. Although not seen in the movie, [[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2005)|''Star Wars: Complete Locations'']] points out a "multifingered former podracer, now a deft pickpocket" that can be located inside the cantina. It may be another [[Xexto/Legends|Xexto]] podracer, but no other Xexto podracers have been officially named.

Gasgano, who was normally calm and cool, turned into a bar brawler when he had too much to drink.
